priorDecision.minimumMissingWitness: Bind/authorize at least two complete entombment methods and their physical/magical profiles; demonstrate a paid legal cast on a defended creature, actual failed resistance/admission, each selected mode positively, and useful lawful escape or outside rescue with full budgets, needs/clocks, growth, suppression/resumption, corpse/gear and competing-source branches.
requiredContent: An authorized finite menu of at least two meaningful entombment methods, with exact creature eligibility/resistance and each method's actual body-fit shape/location/material or magical boundary; no method, dimensions, AC/HP or burial depth is supplied by the native card.

Each mode's Instantaneous versus persistent-result lifecycle, needs/awareness/agency, physical/magical escape and external rescue with actual costs, barriers/tools/checks and source-owned release conditions.
Complete mode-specific growth/attachment/partial-suppression/resumption-collision/death/corpse/gear/recast and competing-source outcomes, with durable ownership and once-only terminal settlement.

priorBlocker.minimumMissingWitness: Bind/authorize at least two complete entombment methods and their physical/magical profiles; demonstrate a paid legal cast on a defended creature, actual failed resistance/admission, each selected mode positively, and useful lawful escape or outside rescue with full budgets, needs/clocks, growth, suppression/resumption, corpse/gear and competing-source branches.
priorBlocker.wholeSpellGate: The missing contract controls the native positive travel/projection or multiple-entombment promise. Optional conditional external branches cannot replace that central effect.
priorBlocker.notAsserted: No claim that these mechanics are impossible, the Astral is nonexistent, class sources are absent, or all planar travel is prohibited.
